data.body: Additional context: dso.workflow=local was confirmed active at the time of this incident (verified in .claude/dso-config.conf). Under dso.workflow=local, the enforcement strategy is LOCAL — meaning the LLM review gate (pre-commit-review-gate.sh) MUST run before every commit, and commits without a passing review MUST fail. The sub-agents bypassing raw git commit should have been blocked by the local enforcement layer. This confirms the bug has two dimensions: (1) sprint orchestrator prompts instructed raw git commit instead of COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md, and (2) the local enforcement layer did not prevent the bypass — either the worktree-isolated sub-agents did not inherit the hook configuration, or the hook was not triggered in the worktree context. Investigating hook inheritance in worktree-isolated sub-agent sessions is a required follow-up.
